scripts.dev: pnpm run copy:web && tsup src/main.ts --format cjs --watch --external electron --onSuccess "electron ."
scripts.copy:web: mkdir -p public && cp -r ../web/dist/* public/ && cp ../../packages/core/assets/notify-logo.png public/
scripts.prebuild: nx build web && pnpm run copy:web
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run prebuild && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: pnpm run prebuild && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:linux: pnpm run prebuild && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux
